text:
maria (partnerships): Folks, starting the cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure — want to sync on initial checklist and who owns what. Target: have AWS and GCP live draft by end of next sprint.

jake (product): Agree. We should decide packaging first: SaaS listing (direct API) vs VM/AMI/VM image for private infra. SaaS is faster.

kevin (cloudops): SaaS listing needs partner-managed billing + meter integration for AWS & Azure. GCP can be SaaS or container image. For AMI/VM we need validated image build + startup scripts.

emily (marketing): Also need co-marketing assets, logo pack, one-pager, and a short 90s explainer video. Marketplace blurbs differ per vendor — I can create drafts.

maria (partnerships): Action items proposal: 1) decide SKU model per vendor (subscription vs metered). 2) compile legal/contract asks. 3) create listing assets. 4) run partner portal tests. Who volunteers?

sophia (legal): I'll own legal/contract asks. Need to know if we'll offer private offers (Azure/ AWS) & reseller co-sell (AWS ISV) — those require reseller agreements and sometimes SOC2 evidence. Also: EULA draft, data residency notes for EU.

jake (product): I can own SKU model + packaging. Proposal: default = SaaS monthly subscription + metered token add-on. For AWS we should also offer an AMI for customers who need VPC-only.

kevin (cloudops): I will own AMI/VM builds and CI for image publication. Need to confirm base AMI, hardened SSH, KMS integration for keys. For GCP marketplace we might push a container image on GCR.

emily (marketing): I'll prepare the marketplace copy + screenshots. Need sandbox orgs for each marketplace to capture UI screenshots. Also will draft announcement copy, but timing must sync with listing approvals.

maria (partnerships): marketplace-bot, please create a ticket for this onboarding and assign sub-tasks. :pray:

marketplace-bot: Created MP-234: "Cloud Marketplace Onboarding - AWS/GCP/Azure". Subtasks: SKU definition, Legal (EULA), AMI build, Sandbox test, Assets. Assignee: unassigned.

sophia (legal): Quick Q: do we plan to accept marketplace billing only, or also direct invoicing for enterprise? Some customers require private offers + invoice. Need to know for contract flow.

jake (product): Mix. Marketplace billing for small/PLG, private offer + invoice for enterprise. That affects SKU design: publish a public monthly plan + hidden private offer SKUs.

kevin (cloudops): Testing note: for AWS SaaS subscriptions we need to implement the AWS Marketplace Metering Service or use Marketplace SaaS integration (API). Let's add a spike ticket to test the entitlement callback URL flow.

maria (partnerships): Good catch. Add spike: `MP-234-1` to verify AWS SaaS entitlement flow and GCP SaaS connector.

emily (marketing): Timeline check — is it okay to aim for AWS draft live week 1, GCP draft week 2, Azure week 3? We can stagger announcements to avoid coord overhead.

sophia (legal): That sounds fine. I will prioritize the EULA + data processing addendum (DPA) and review marketplace-specific terms (Azure has its own seller terms).

jake (product): One more product detail: we need a lite plan with limited tokens & a professional plan with higher throughput + priority support. Add `support-level` field in listing metadata.

kevin (cloudops): For private offers, ensure the deployment artifacts include an automated license key fetcher from the partner portal or use BYOK for keys. I'll draft the terraform + cloud-init templates.

maria (partnerships): Great. I'll compile everything into the onboarding checklist and share a single-page PRD. Emily — can you collect the logos and provide exact file formats required for each marketplace?

emily (marketing): Yup — will provide logos in SVG/PNG at multiple sizes, a 1-line, 2-line, and long description, plus four product screenshots. I'll upload to MP-234.

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled in 3 days: "Marketplace onboarding standup".

maria (partnerships): Thanks all. Final quick calls: Jake + Kevin — sync on metering APIs today. Sophia + me — we'll align on private offer flows. Emily — send draft copy by EOD Thursday.

jake (product): On it.

kevin (cloudops): I'll spin a test account and post creds to MP-234 (secure).

sophia (legal): Will review drafts once posted.

emily (marketing): Will post assets by Thu EOD. :rocket:
